home.hero_subtitle: If you are feeling unsafe online, there are many local and global resources that can help you reclaim your sense of security: from civil and criminal penalties, to non-profit psychosocial support, to formal takedown requests direct to IT companies. But navigating those resources and determining who to reach out to (and how) can be overwhelming.
home.description_2: If you can answer a few questions about what's making you feel unsafe, Gabay Tech will recommend organizations and resources that can help based on your unique situation.
home.disclaimer: DISCLAIMER: this tool does not constitute legal advice. Use of this tool is completely anonymous: no user data is collected or stored. If for some reason you feel unsafe while using this tool, utilize the “emergency exit” button and return when you are safe. If you are in imminent danger, please contact 911 immediately.
